The '''1983 Copa del Rey final''' was the 81st final of the [[Copa del Rey]]. The final was played at [[La Romareda]] in [[Zaragoza]], on 4 June 1983, being won by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]], who beat [[Real Madrid CF|Real Madrid]] 2–1.

[[File:Grada_Sur_de_La_Romareda_2019.jpg|thumb|left|La Romareda Stadium in Zaragoza, venue of the final]]
{{-}}
